description: Review the changes from three angles at once, then fix each finding in turn and run the check.
input: What to review, such as the uncommitted changes or a folder

parallel.prompt: Review {{input}} for security problems only: injection, secrets, unchecked input.
Review {{input}} for missing or weak tests only.
Review {{input}} for type and null-safety problems only.

prompt: Merge them into at most 5 findings worth fixing, most important first, each as path:line and one sentence.

stages.prompt: Fix this one finding, and nothing else: {{item}}
